notes: Reviewed slot removals for rows the protected workbook carries in the wrong procedure template. Applied by scripts/ip-preference-cards/apply-procedure-template-corrections.ts, after the reviewed additions and before the external-review overlays. Every removal restates the row's procedure, role, and section, so a drifted workbook fails the import rather than deleting whatever the id points at now. Removals change only the current template: previously published module, recipe, and release versions retain the removed rows verbatim in the module and composition ledgers, so historical cards still reconstruct.
